description:
Arctic Reindeer: Why Reindeer Eyes Turn Deep Blue in Winter! — Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer had a shiny nose! But did you know arctic reindeer have eyes that literally CHANGE COLOR from golden to deep blue?
Kids science answer for "reindeer science facts for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

In bright arctic summer, reindeer eyes have golden reflective layers. But in dark winter, pupil pressure compacts the eye's tapetum lucidum collagen fibers, turning them deep blue to scatter light and see in the dark!

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
